propositions: A frozen, versioned corpus of ~4,300 plan_review_result_v2 sidecars with reconstructed plan text (via git EDIT/SNAPSHOT history) and material-fingerprint-validated normalization must be built to enable offline replay.

Tier-0 (Pass-3 deterministic replay), Tier-1 (Pass-2 on stored findings, ~$0.5/review), and Tier-2 (Pass-1 on stratified sample, ~$3.4/review) eval runners must measure changes to criteria, questions, and thresholds within a hard $200 Bedrock budget with $30 reserve.

Every LLM call must use production model class via Bedrock only (Opus for Pass-1, Sonnet for Pass-2), with per-pass model id recorded and validation that model changes are refused; prompt caching must be confirmed active (cache_read_tokens > 0) on subsequent calls.

Reviewer-noise floor must be computed from 208 verdict flips on identical-material reviews and used to determine whether a proposal's label-proxy deltas represent real improvement/regression or fall within noise bands.
